about.description:
Xvfb (X virtual framebuffer) is an X.Org display server that performs all
rendering into virtual memory without any physical display hardware or
output. It is the standard way to run GUI applications, take screenshots,
and run graphical test suites on headless machines and in CI.

This build is the Xvfb DDX only (Xorg, Xnest and Xephyr are disabled). It
ships libXfont2's built-in fonts (fixed, cursor, 6x13) so it starts without
external font packages, and uses xkbcomp + xkeyboard-config for keyboard
support. GLX is enabled; GLX rendering needs a swrast_dri.so on
DRI_DRIVER_PATH (${PREFIX}/lib/dri) at runtime (e.g. from system Mesa, or a
conda Mesa software-GL package). For display-less off-screen OpenGL, OSMesa
or EGL-surfaceless need no X server at all.
about.summary: Xvfb, the X.Org virtual framebuffer (headless) X server

commands:
Xvfb :98 -screen 0 1280x1024x24 -nolisten tcp -noreset &
XVFB_PID=$!
RC=1
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if [ -e /tmp/.X11-unix/X98 ] || [ -e /tmp/.X98-lock ]; then RC=0; break; fi
  sleep 0.5
done
kill "${XVFB_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "${XVFB_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
exit ${RC}

name: xorg-xvfb-server
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "21.1.24" %}

package:
  name: xorg-xvfb-server
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://www.x.org/releases/individual/xserver/xorg-server-{{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: 1a4eb36ca65cc3b1b936566d677a9786e13c11cd5806e951ac55f3f5ce3984af

build:
  number: 0
  skip: true  # [not linux]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}
    - meson
    - ninja
    - pkg-config
  host:
    - xorg-xorgproto
    - xorg-xtrans
    - xorg-font-util
    - xorg-libxdmcp
    - xorg-libxau
    - libxkbfile
    - libxfont2
    - pixman
    - openssl
    - libgl-devel
  run:
    - xkbcomp
    - xkeyboard-config

test:
  commands:
    - test -f "${PREFIX}/bin/Xvfb"
    - Xvfb -help 2>&1 | grep -qi "screen scrn WxHxD"
    - |
      Xvfb :98 -screen 0 1280x1024x24 -nolisten tcp -noreset &
      XVFB_PID=$!
      RC=1
      for i in $(seq 1 30); do
        if [ -e /tmp/.X11-unix/X98 ] || [ -e /tmp/.X98-lock ]; then RC=0; break; fi
        sleep 0.5
      done
      kill "${XVFB_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
      wait "${XVFB_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
      exit ${RC}

about:
  home: https://www.x.org/
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: Xvfb, the X.Org virtual framebuffer (headless) X server
  description: |
    Xvfb (X virtual framebuffer) is an X.Org display server that performs all
    rendering into virtual memory without any physical display hardware or
    output. It is the standard way to run GUI applications, take screenshots,
    and run graphical test suites on headless machines and in CI.

    This build is the Xvfb DDX only (Xorg, Xnest and Xephyr are disabled). It
    ships libXfont2's built-in fonts (fixed, cursor, 6x13) so it starts without
    external font packages, and uses xkbcomp + xkeyboard-config for keyboard
    support. GLX is enabled; GLX rendering needs a swrast_dri.so on
    DRI_DRIVER_PATH (${PREFIX}/lib/dri) at runtime (e.g. from system Mesa, or a
    conda Mesa software-GL package). For display-less off-screen OpenGL, OSMesa
    or EGL-surfaceless need no X server at all.
  dev_url: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/xorg/xserver

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - hmaarrfk
